The document contains specifications for two ultrasonic flowmeters: Molten Salt and HTF.
Both meters have a bidirectional flow measurement capability.
Wetted calibration certificates are required for all flow transmitters.
Performance guarantees start from the official startup date of the solar power plant.
Field support is mandatory during the commissioning phase.
The instrument is an ultrasonic flowmeter for molten salt and hot fluid.
It has a flow rate range of 0 - 7,500 gpm.
Accuracy is ± 0.5% with a velocity range of 0.5 m/sec to 20 m/sec.
The transmitter outputs are dual channel with both analog and digital options.
Field installation is remote, requiring 4-Wire Transmitter / 120 VAC power supply.
